name: Biphalin
summary: Biphalin is a dimeric enkephalin endogenous peptide (Tyr-D-Ala-Gly-Phe-NH)2 composed of two tetrapeptides derived from enkephalins, connected 'tail-to-tail' by a hydrazide bridge. The presence of two distinct pharmacophores confers on biphalin a high affinity for both μ and δ opioid receptors (with an EC50 of about 1–5 nM for both μ and δ receptors), therefore it has analgesic activity.

pharmacology.text: The presence of two distinct pharmacophores confers on biphalin a high affinity for both μ and δ opioid receptors (with an EC50 of about 1–5 nM for both μ and δ receptors), therefore it has analgesic activity. The hydrazide linker is not fundamental for activity or binding, and it can be conveniently substituted by different conformationally constrained cycloaliphatic diamine linkers.

uses.en: It is a research peptide used to study opioid receptors and pain. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是用來研究鴉片受體與疼痛的研究用胜肽，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是用来研究鸦片受体与疼痛的研究用胜肽，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It is two enkephalin fragments joined tail to tail, so the molecule has two identical business ends. That doubling gives it unusually strong binding at both the mu and delta opioid receptors.
fact.zh: 它由兩段腦磷肽尾對尾接合而成，因此分子有兩個完全相同的活性端。這種「加倍」使它在 μ 與 δ 鴉片受體上都有異常強的結合力。
fact.zhHans: 它由两段脑磷肽尾对尾接合而成，因此分子有两个完全相同的活性端。这种「加倍」使它在 μ 与 δ 鸦片受体上都有异常强的结合力。
